lead: How your knife gets to you.
We ship within Germany for €7.99 per item and worldwide if you cover all costs involved. You can also collect your knife at the workshop in Stein am Kocher.

items.x: €7.99 per item. Delivery time depends on whether you order a finished knife or a custom piece; the expected time is given with your order.
We ship outside Germany if you cover all costs involved – shipping, insurance and any fees. Ask for the costs to your country before ordering.
If customs duties or import taxes apply, they are added to the price.
Many countries restrict the import of certain knives, especially folding and hunting knives. Please check the rules in your country before you order.
Collect your knife by appointment at Wannenstraße 33, 74196 Neuenstadt am Kocher (Stein am Kocher), Germany – free of charge, for customers from anywhere in the world.
Bank transfer – your order is confirmed once payment has been received
Email us with the knife you are interested in and your country – in English or German.

faq.q: Do you ship knives outside Germany?
faq.a: Yes, if you cover all costs involved – shipping, insurance and any fees. Alternatively, you can collect your knife from the workshop in person.
If customs duties or import taxes apply, they are added to the price.
By bank transfer; your order is confirmed once payment has been received. When collecting in person, you can also pay in cash or by card.
